business_model.basis: Stated in the 10-K Item 1 business description.
business_model.claim: Corteva sells seed and crop protection products to farmers worldwide. The 10-K says it serves about 110 countries.
quotes: Corteva is a leading global provider of seed and crop protection solutions focused on the agriculture industry

business_model.basis: Stated in the 10-K and the 10-Q MD&A.
business_model.claim: Through 2025 the company reported two operating segments, Seed and Crop Protection. Per the Q3 10-Q, the company has since completed the separation of the Seed segment into Vylor Inc.
quotes: The company’s operations are managed through two operating segments: Seed and Crop Protection.

On October 1, 2026, the company completed its previously announced separation into two independent, publicly traded companies through the separation of Corteva’s seed operating segment into an independent, publicly traded company, Vylor Inc.

business_model.claim: Seed reaches customers through the Pioneer agency model (direct to farmers via independent sales representatives), regional seed brands, retail and out-licensing of traits and germplasm to third parties.
quotes: The Pioneer agency model is unique to Corteva and represents sales made directly to farmers primarily via independent sales representatives.

business_model.basis: Inferred from the pro forma product-line table and the 10-K product descriptions.
business_model.claim: Crop Protection sells herbicides, insecticides, fungicides and biologicals. In the pro forma 'New Corteva' nine-month table, herbicides are the largest line at 2,690 of 5,357 net sales.
Sales are seasonal: about 60 percent come in the first half of the calendar year and about 40 percent in the second half, with the second half led by southern hemisphere Seed.
quotes: The company typically generates about 60 percent of its sales in the first half of the calendar year, driven by northern hemisphere Seed and Crop Protection sales.

business_model.claim: Revenue moves with price, volume and currency. In 2025 net sales were $17,401 million, up 3 percent, from a 1 percent price increase and a 3 percent volume increase, offset by a 1 percent unfavorable currency impact.
quotes: The company reported net sales of $17,401 million, an increase of 3 percent versus the year ended December 31, 2024, reflecting a 1 percent increase in price and a 3 percent increase in volume, partially offset by a 1 percent unfavorable currency impact.

business_model.claim: In Q3 2026 net sales were $2,458 million, down 6 percent, on a 6 percent volume decline and a 2 percent price decline, partly offset by 2 percent favorable currency. Price fell on competitive Crop Protection pricing in Latin America and acetochlor in North America, while Seed pricing rose.
quotes: The decrease in price was driven by competitive Crop Protection pricing in Latin America and North America acetochlor, partially offset by Seed pricing increases across all regions which were driven by higher out-licensing income and demand for top technology.

business_model.basis: Stated in the 8-K earnings release (pro forma figures).
business_model.claim: The post-spin pro forma Q3 release shows pricing pressure concentrated in Brazil and U.S. acetochlor. Pro forma net sales fell 9% and Latin America fell 28%.
quotes: Pricing declined 7%, driven by competitive pressure on molecules late in their lifecycle in Brazil and U.S. acetochlor.

business_model.claim: Cost of goods sold is the largest cost. It was $9,172 million, or 53 percent of net sales, in 2025, down from $9,529 million, or 56 percent, in 2024, helped by cost and productivity actions, raw material deflation and lower net royalty expense.
quotes: COGS was $9,172 million (53 percent of net sales) for the year ended December 31, 2025 compared to $9,529 million (56 percent of net sales) for the year ended December 31, 2024.

business_model.claim: R&D and SG&A are the other large operating costs. In 2025, R&D was $1,474 million and SG&A was $3,492 million. SG&A rose on commissions, variable compensation and bad debt expense.
Key inputs are third-party contract seed growers for Seed and chemical intermediates for Crop Protection, with a material portion of crop protection inputs sourced directly or indirectly from China.
quotes: To produce high-quality seeds, the company contracts with third-party growers globally.
Currently, a material portion of the company’s crop protection inputs are sourced directly or indirectly from China.
